notes: *this man*: the demonstrative pronoun holds the single written determiner and both articles are unrepresented, matching rule 41's `הַמָּקוֹם הַהוּא` → *that place*.

The copula *were* is placed on שָׁם as the predicate of the verbless clause, which is the ASV's own construal (*priests unto Jehovah* standing as appositive); the competing reading puts it on כֹּהֲנִים and is named in the unit note under rule 8.

*from year to year*: each occurrence carries a rendered relational morpheme — מִן for the first and the directive he for the second — so rule 2 splits them and nothing is left unrendered (rules 22, 32).
The numeral takes only *two* while the counted noun בְנֵי takes the supplied *the* (rule 15).
